svg.aria-label: Two panels, same input: a customer searches for red sneakers, then refines to red sneakers under 100 euros while the first search is still running. Left, a step graph with shared state: the slow first search overwrites the results slot and the reply shows its items for the second query. Right, a libpetri Petri net: result tokens keep their query id, the reply transition fires only when result and open query carry the same id, and the late token is drained.
svg.title: libpetri: results pair by identity

path.aria-label: Coloured Time Petri nets for concurrent orchestration
Java · TypeScript · Rust · Python · open source, Apache-2.0
steps hand results over through one shared slot
libpetri: every token keeps the id of its query
Results pair by identity, not by arrival order.
The id match is part of the firing rule: there is no check-then-act gap. Runs in production, checked by Z3 in CI.
